title: Sparkly telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='tube' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffcf5c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e08a1e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tube2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#7fd8ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3a9fd6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff6a8'>
    <path d='M14 18 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2z'/>
    <path d='M82 12 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6z'/>
    <path d='M88 44 l1.8 4.5 4.5 1.8 -4.5 1.8 -1.8 4.5 -1.8 -4.5 -4.5 -1.8 4.5 -1.8z'/>
    <path d='M10 62 l1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6z'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='20' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='46' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='72' r='2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tripod -->
  <g stroke='#c2713a' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>
    <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='30' y2='90'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='70' y2='90'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='92'/>
  </g>
  <!-- mount head -->
  <rect x='44' y='52' width='12' height='10' rx='3' fill='#ff9f4a'/>
  <!-- tube angled up-right -->
  <g transform='rotate(-35 50 50)'>
    <rect x='22' y='42' width='56' height='18' rx='6' fill='url(#tube)'/>
    <rect x='22' y='42' width='56' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- tube band -->
    <rect x='56' y='42' width='7' height='18' fill='#3a9fd6'/>
    <!-- eyepiece -->
    <rect x='12' y='44' width='12' height='14' rx='3' fill='#ff9f4a'/>
    <rect x='8' y='46' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#7fd8ff'/>
    <!-- front lens rim -->
    <rect x='76' y='40' width='8' height='22' rx='3' fill='#3a9fd6'/>
    <ellipse cx='84' cy='51' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#bff0ff'/>
  </g>
</svg>
